headline: Sensex and Nifty seek direction amid FII inflows, oil prices, and upcoming WPI inflation data

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: WPI inflation data, crude oil prices, and FII trading activity are expected to guide stock market direction this week.
Sensex and Nifty extended weekly gains for a third straight week driven by foreign institutional investors buying.
Rotation away from global AI trades has helped fuel a comeback in India's equity markets.
Markets snapped a three-day rally at the end of last week as Sensex tumbled over 300 points.
whatHappening: Analysts highlighted Hero MotoCorp, Bharti Airtel, and Indus Towers among top buy ideas for November 16.
Smallcap indices jumped 3.6% while PSU banks surged 7.5% over the past week.
GIFT Nifty trends indicated a cautious opening for Indian benchmark indices.
Government and private health insurance spending in India crossed 20% of total health expenditure.
summary: Indian benchmark indices enter the week after logging a third consecutive week of gains backed by strong foreign fund inflows. Investors will closely watch WPI inflation numbers, oil price movements, and FII trading activity for market cues. Stocks including Hero MotoCorp, Bharti Airtel, and Indus Towers are in focus following fresh analyst buy recommendations.
